execution_evidence.truth_boundary: Selector-bound, unlike NRRD-R1-SOURCE-TESTS: it names the exact test files and per-selector outcomes for the endian obligations, and is backed by bidirectional evidence from Teem 1.12.0, a genuinely independent C reference implementation that shares no code with format_factory. Covers TC-FF6-NRRD-GOLDEN-SLICE-001 (raw scalar payload guards) and TC-FF6-NRRD-ASCII-ENDIAN-001 (endian/encoding scoping) only; it supports no other obligation and promotes no product state.
The transcript records 58 production-namespace and 219 legacy tests passing at commit 767e7006, but it does not bind individual selector outcomes and is non-promoting support only.
